name: aria-page-e2e
description: 页面 E2E P1(地基+冒烟):真实 aria CLI 单端口服务 + 真实页面的 S0-S3 冒烟。与 web/ 依赖完全隔离。

scripts.smoke: node env/assemble.ts && playwright test; rc=$?; node env/teardown.ts; exit $rc
scripts.journey: node env/assemble-real.ts && node scripts/run-real-journey.ts; rc=$?; node env/teardown.ts; exit $rc
scripts.journey:resume: node env/restart-real.ts && node scripts/run-real-journey.ts; rc=$?; node env/teardown.ts; exit $rc
